in_sanskrit.name: Jagvitha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jagvitha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jagat (universe) + Itha (residence or abode) = Jagvitha, Goddess of victory. She is the divine power that bestows victory and success upon her devotees.

in_hindi.name: Jagvitha
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of victory
in_hindi.long_meaning: Jagvitha एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jagat (universe) + Itha (residence or abode) = Jagvitha, Goddess of victory. She is the divine power that bestows victory and success upon her devotees.

in_tamil.name: Jagvitha
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Goddess of victory
in_tamil.long_meaning: Jagvitha ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Jagat (universe) + Itha (residence or abode) = Jagvitha, Goddess of victory. She is the divine power that bestows victory and success upon her devotees.

in_telugu.name: Jagvitha
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Goddess of victory
in_telugu.long_meaning: Jagvitha ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Jagat (universe) + Itha (residence or abode) = Jagvitha, Goddess of victory. She is the divine power that bestows victory and success upon her devotees.

in_marathi.name: Jagvitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagvitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagat (universe) + Itha (residence or abode) = Jagvitha, Goddess of victory. She is the divine power that bestows victory and success upon her devotees.

in_bengali.name: Jagvitha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of victory
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jagvitha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jagat (universe) + Itha (residence or abode) = Jagvitha, Goddess of victory. She is the divine power that bestows victory and success upon her devotees.
